sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.country_name FROM university T1 JOIN university_year T2 ON T1.id=T2.university_id JOIN country T3 ON T3.id=T1.country_id WHERE T2.year=2013 AND T2.num_students*100 > (SELECT AVG(num_students) FROM university_year)*98

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_international_students AS REAL)/100) FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Harvard University' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_international_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Harvard University' AND T1.year=2012
SELECT CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Stanford University' AND T1.year=2011

SELECT T1.num_students - CAST(T1.num_students*T1.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year T1 JOIN university T2 ON T1.university_id=T2.id WHERE T2.university_name='Emory University' AND T1.year=2011

SELECT c.country_name, CAST(y.num_students*y.pct_female_students AS REAL)/100 FROM university_year y JOIN university u ON u.id=y.university_id JOIN country c ON c.id=u.country_id WHERE y.year=2011 AND y.university_id=23

SELECT DISTINCT u.university_name FROM university u JOIN university_ranking_year r ON u.id=r.university_id WHERE r.year=2015 AND r.score*100 < (SELECT AVG(score) FROM university_ranking_year WHERE year=2015)*28
